meta.title: Remote control
meta.description: Pair your phone to view and control DSH sessions on this computer through a temporary HTTPS connection.

ui.title: Remote control
ui.intro: Continue your DSH sessions from your phone.
ui.toggleDescription: Create a temporary HTTPS connection for your paired devices.
ui.permission: After scanning and pairing, the device can view and control DSH sessions on this computer.
ui.disableNotice: Turning off remote control disconnects all remote devices and invalidates the pairing link.
ui.localOnly: Manage remote control on this computer.
ui.dependencyMissing: cloudflared is unavailable on this computer. Install it using the plugin’s setup instructions, then retry.
ui.offHint: Turn on remote control to create a pairing QR code.
ui.startingHint: Preparing your secure connection. This may take a moment.
ui.pairingHint: Scan with your phone’s camera, or open the pairing link on the device you want to connect.
ui.qrAlt: QR code to pair a device with this computer
ui.qrUnavailable: The QR code could not be displayed. Use the pairing link or generate a new code.
ui.pairingNone: Generate a QR code to pair another device.
ui.pairingExpired: This pairing link has expired. Generate a new QR code to continue.
ui.copyFailed: Could not copy the link. Select it and copy it manually.
ui.revokeHint: Revoking access disconnects the device. It must scan a new QR code to reconnect.
ui.streamDisconnected: Live updates disconnected. Reconnect to refresh the current status.
ui.networkFailed: Could not reach this computer. Check the connection and retry.
ui.requestTimeout: The request timed out. Retry to check the current status.
ui.invalidResponse: The computer returned an invalid response. Retry to refresh the status.
ui.connectionError: Remote control could not start. Check the details and retry.
ui.credentialsExpired: This device has expired or its access was revoked. Pair it again.
